subject.title: feat(github-copilot): add native web search for Copilot GPT models

question: Should Copilot-native web search replace managed-provider auto-selection when `tools.web.search.provider` is unset, or require the existing explicit `openai` selector?
rationale: Both behaviors are technically supportable, but the current PR silently changes existing users’ search routing and provider choice on upgrade; repository policy treats that default decision as compatibility-sensitive product intent.

options.title: Preserve current defaults
options.body: Require `tools.web.search.provider: "openai"` for Copilot-native search so existing unset-provider installations keep managed-provider auto-selection.

options.title: Adopt zero-config native search
options.body: Approve unset-provider Copilot models switching automatically to Copilot-native search and document the upgrade behavior prominently.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers have stronger upstream and user evidence for changing Copilot’s default search routing.

recommendation.title: Preserve current defaults
recommendation.body: Require `tools.web.search.provider: "openai"` for Copilot-native search so existing unset-provider installations keep managed-provider auto-selection.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this person most directly to both Copilot stream routing and the plugin SDK provider boundary involved in the decision.
